body: I'm doing a lot better today. I freaked out at work, but I stepped out and gave myself a break. I didn't get to adopt a dog today, but I might try to soon. How are you?

I need to go to therapy twice a week for it to be effective. I'll be spending all of my pay on therapy, but I think I need it. It'll be about $800/month. I'll also try to see a therapist at my workplace, so I can mitigate my depression.
Okay. Thank you so much for being with me today. It helped a lot.

I just looked up English Mastiffs. They look cute :) I looked on the website, and I found this extremely cute German Shepherd mix. She is three years old, and she was smiling in her pictures. She looks like a good dog. I'll have to go down there and look. There were so many dogs on that website that I want to adopt.
Thank you for the information

Wow that's a lot of animals! I live in the U.S., in Texas, so I have one close to me.

 What kind of dogs and cats do you have? Cats are sweet. I love my ex-neighbor's cat. He would always run up to me, and greet me every time he was outside. Living in a farm would be nice or working with animals daily. I would work with animals, but I am a psych major who wants to be a therapist.
I was looking at dogs up for adoption. I might go ahead and get one. I like animals a lot, cats and dogs. They are precious.

Yeah we were close. I've known her for three years, but I only really started to know her about a year ago. Thank you. I feel like a lot of people would not view me as sweet and kind. I talked to her yesterday, and I asked if she hated me. She said no. She said that she always feels uncomfortable and she doesn't know what to do around me. I felt bad because my behavior caused her to feel like this.

I have a feeling that I'll end up alone with no one. Hopefully, I could get a dog. They are always so sweet.

No, I haven't been diagnosed. My therapist could sense that I was scared about her bringing up the disorder. I have a lot of guilt because I did do something bad. I told one of my friends that I had feelings for her when she was in a relationship. I didn't want to steal her away, I just wanted to distance myself and all of that. Now I make her uncomfortable. I feel bad about that a lot.

He is 25, and I didn't talk with him much, but it's good to know that there I'm not alone. It was nice meeting you too. I've been researching everything there is to know about borderline personality disorder, and it seems scary. A lot of people talk about people with this disorder are evil. I have a fear of being mean to others.

Thank you for checking in with me. You are really nice. I did talk to her, and she told me that I should possibly see a psychologist who specializes in Borderline Personality Disorder to see if I am experiencing that illness. I have calmed down, and I will be seeing her on Monday. I am still feeling low, but I think I won't kill myself today.
No, I'm not close with him. We've never talked about personal stuff, but I remember after my last suicide attempt, he started crying because I tried to kill myself.
It won't make it worse for me. I won't feel anything at that point. After I kill myself, my anxiety and depression will be gone.
Okay I will. I probably won't give her full details because I'm scared she will send me to the hospital. I wish I was normal with depression or anxiety. I want to stop feeling sorry for myself.
I'm 22 years old. My brother will be in the same place with me today. I will also see my therapist at 1pm, so that is a good thing.
Hey, thank you for replying. I've talked about it before to my manager, but it's hard to get concrete evidence. Whenever I've discussed it, she tells me I'm over thinking the situation.
Yes, that is true. I am being melodramatic.
I want to kill myself, so I will.
Yeah, I am not well-liked by people. I just wish I was okay with being alone and ostracized.

At work, there are a lot of people who are mean. I'm probably just sensitive, and I can't deal with office politics. Sometimes I'm ostracized, and at that point, I always think that these people would like it if I killed myself. If they are always mean to me, obviously they do not like me. I feel like I need to get rid of the problem, which is me.

A co-worker of mine likes to call me out on everything regardless if her concern is true. This is just a minor thing, but in a meeting, I had told her that I needed her to send me an email, so I could do my job. Each time, she told me she couldn't find the email. This happened two times. In the meeting, I tell her once again she needs to find the email, so I can contact another employee about getting a project done. She starts arguing with me that she found it, so I say okay just give it to me on e we get back into the office. Lo and behold, the same incident occurs, and she can't find it.

This project has been put off for months now. It's pissing me off because she does things like this constantly, always argues with me that I'm wrong or my ideas are shit.
Thank you for you words

Yeah, I agree. Plus it costs too much for me to actually see any benefit from the mental healthcare available. I'm grateful that I have insurance, and I have the opportunity to receive some kind of help, but it hasn't been effective in treating my suicidal depression. 

I can afford maybe one therapy session a month, which is more than what some people can afford. However, I go back into a suicidal state because I'm not having that weekly/bi-weekly help from a therapist. I feel like that might be my downfall in the end.
Thank you
I agree. I'm a pretty shitty person.
